name: town-meadows
mood: Northstar Town, a cozy lakeside company town on a bright spring morning. Storybook, handcrafted, premium; lush layered greens, warm wood, black cast iron, weathered stone, brass. Everything sized for a town where a person is about as tall as a lamp post's lower half.

items.prompt: A square raised vegetable bed built from weathered cedar planks, filling its floor diamond, planted in tidy rows: frilly lettuces, feathery carrot tops, a few red tomatoes on a little cane, dark rich soil between the rows.
A square raised bed built from weathered cedar planks, filling its floor diamond, packed with cutting flowers: tall sunflowers in the middle, pink cosmos and orange zinnias around them.
A square raised herb bed built from weathered cedar planks, filling its floor diamond: mounds of purple-flowering lavender, silvery sage, bright green basil and chives with little purple pompoms.
Two stacked white-painted wooden beehive boxes with a pitched honey-brown roof on a low stone stand, a couple of tiny bees; symmetric, the same from every side.
A small orchard apple tree: a rounded crown of fresh green leaves dotted with shiny red apples, a short gnarled trunk, a few fallen apples in the grass at its base.
A small orchard pear tree: a rounded crown of glossy leaves with golden-green pears and a few white blossoms, a short gnarled trunk, a woven basket of pears at its base.

A square red-and-white gingham picnic blanket spread flat on the grass, filling its floor diamond, with a wicker picnic basket, a plate of sandwiches, two lemonade glasses and a bowl of strawberries in the middle.

A square blue-and-cream striped picnic blanket spread flat on the grass, filling its floor diamond, with a wicker basket, an open book, a teapot and two cups, and a little bunch of wildflowers in the middle.
An outdoor bronze armillary sphere sculpture: interlocking polished bronze rings with a verdigris patina, on a round weathered stone plinth; symmetric, the same from every side.
A tall balanced-stone cairn sculpture: smooth river stones of warm grey and ochre stacked in a graceful tapering column on a round stone base, a little moss at the bottom; the same from every side.
A modern outdoor sculpture of a faceted brushed-brass five-pointed star standing upright on a slim dark steel post over a round pale stone plinth, catching the sun.
A round carved stone bird bath on a fluted pedestal, a shallow bowl of blue water with a little sparrow perched on its rim and some ivy curling round the pedestal.
A loose drift of meadow wildflowers growing in the grass: red poppies, blue cornflowers and white ox-eye daisies on slender stems, airy and natural, no pot or edging.
A loose clump of tall cottage-garden wildflowers growing in the grass: purple lupins, pink foxgloves and a few yellow buttercups, no pot or edging.
A round campfire ring of grey fieldstones with split logs stacked in a tepee in the middle and small warm flames and glowing embers; symmetric, the same from every side.
A short black cast-iron garden lantern on a slim post, a square glass lamp with a little pointed cap and a warm candle glow inside; symmetric, the same from every side.
A round tree-stump seat with pale sawn rings on top, rough dark bark, a little moss and a mushroom at its foot; the same from every side.
A friendly garden scarecrow on a wooden post: straw hat, patched plaid shirt with straw poking out of the cuffs, a stitched smiling burlap face, arms out on a crossbar, a crow perched on one arm.

prompts.nw: The same friendly garden scarecrow seen from BEHIND: the back of its straw hat and burlap head, the back of its patched plaid shirt with straw poking out, arms out on the crossbar, the wooden post, a crow on one arm.
